Export benchmark evidence bundles to JSON/TOML formats

Usage: franken-benchmark-evidence-export [OPTIONS] --input <FILE> --output <FILE>

Options:
  -i, --input <FILE>                      Input evidence bundle JSON file
  -o, --output <FILE>                     Output file path
  -f, --format <FORMAT>                   Output format: json or toml [default: json]
  -t, --type <TYPE>                       Export type: bundle or report [default: bundle]
      --gate-integration <GATE_MANIFEST>  Path to benchmark gate manifest for integration
  -v, --verbose                           Verbose output
  -h, --help                              Print help
  -V, --version                           Print version
